messages:
Jo (CS): FYI Medivue returned the vendor security questionnaire but left the DPA unsigned and didn't include SOC2 evidence.

Evan S: I reviewed the form. Missing items: signed DPA, SOC2 AOC or report (past 12 months), named KMS/HSM vendor and a short key rotation note.

Jo (CS): I'll ping them for the signed DPA and SOC2. Any preferred DPA version? @Legal

Legal: Use Redwood DPA v3 as baseline. If they request SLA/term edits, capture redlines and a short risk summary. Small SLA tweaks sometimes ok, major changes need exec sign-off.

Jo (CS): Drafting message to Medivue now:
> Hi Medivue team, thanks for the completed questionnaire. Could you please:
> - Attach the signed Redwood DPA (v3)
> - Attach SOC2 evidence (AOC or full report covering the last 12 months)
> - Confirm KMS/HSM vendor for customer-managed keys and provide key rotation cadence
> - Share a simple data flow diagram (PII path) and retention TTLs for embeddings/logs
> We can provide an SFTP link for sensitive uploads.

Evan S: Add this short checklist to the intake record:
- Signed DPA (Redwood DPA v3)
- SOC2 AOC/report (last 12 months)
- KMS/HSM vendor + rotation cadence
- PII data flow diagram
- Retention policy excerpt for embeddings/logs

SecOpsBot: Reminder: Vendor intake "Medivue" has 4 outstanding evidence items. Assigned to Jo (CS). Deadline: 2025-04-02.

Jo (CS): Message sent. Provided SFTP details in DM. I'll upload docs to /shared/customer-evidence/Medivue when they come in.

AM-Liz: Heads-up: renewal check in 5 weeks. If DPA or SOC2 missing at that time mark renewal risk in Gainsight and flag me.

Medivue (reply): We uploaded SOC2 Type 2 (2024) and confirmed Azure Key Vault for keys. DPA unsigned  we requested a 72-hour SLA instead of 48.

Evan S: SOC2 Type 2 ok. SLA change needs Legal review. Jo, please route redlines to Legal and include a short business impact note.

Jo (CS): Uploaded SOC2 to /shared/customer-evidence/Medivue/soc2_2024.pdf and noted key vendor. Routing redlines to Legal now.

SecOpsBot: Evidence upload detected: /shared/customer-evidence/Medivue/soc2_2024.pdf

Legal: Received redlines. Reviewing SLA request now; will aim to respond within 48 hours.

AM-Liz: Marked renewal risk in Gainsight as "pending evidence - legal review" and pinged Customer Success Lead.

Jo (CS): Thanks. We'll keep the intake open until Legal signs off or we get a final DPA. If no legal decision in 3 business days escalate to CS Ops. :thumbsup:
